Class FinishedState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.model.state.FinishedState
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameStateLogic
public class FinishedState extends Object implements GameStateLogic
Represents the terminal phase of the game.

In this state, the game has officially concluded (usually after Era III). The system calculates the final scores, applies any end-game effects (such as invalid input: '{@link /*missing*/}'), and determines the winner. No further gameplay actions can be taken by the players.

    • calculateFinalPrestige

      private int calculateFinalPrestige(Tribe tribe)
      Calculates the final prestige score for a player's tribe at the end of the game.

      The scoring logic aggregates points from four distinct sources:

      • Builders: Sum of static prestige points printed on each Builder card.
      • Inventors: A multiplicative bonus calculated as (number of Inventors) * (number of distinct invention icons).
      • Artists: A set bonus of 10 points for every pair of Artist cards.
      • Buildings: The sum of victory points provided by all constructed buildings.
      Parameters:
      tribe - The Tribe object containing the player's characters, buildings, and assets.
      Returns:
      The total calculated prestige points for the tribe.

      public void placeTotemOnOffer(Game g, Player p, OfferTile t)
      Description copied from interface: GameStateLogic
      Attempts to place a player's totem on an offer tile.

      By default, this action is not allowed and will throw an exception. Only specific states (e.g., PlacingState) that allow this action should override this method to provide the actual implementation.

      Specified by:
      placeTotemOnOffer in interface GameStateLogic
      Parameters:
      g - The main game context. Must not be null.
      p - The player attempting to place the totem.
      t - The offer tile where the totem should be placed.
